lines.en: I head back to the shrine to see if Maya’s there.
lines.zh: 我回神社去看 Maya 在不在。

lines.en: As I reach the top of the stairs, I spot her sweeping the area around a donation box.
lines.zh: 走到台阶顶上，我看见她正在香油箱周围扫地。

lines.en: She greets me with a mix of confusion and surprise before asking me why I’d willingly come back to a place like this."
lines.zh: 她见到我时又困惑又惊讶，然后问我为什么会愿意回到这种地方来。"

lines.en: I tell her it’s out of boredom but, honestly, I just like seeing her in her shrine maiden outfit.
lines.zh: 我说是因为无聊，但其实我只是喜欢看她穿巫女服的样子。

lines.en: Eventually, she asks me to leave so she can go back to focusing on her duties, and I find myself walking back down the stairs shortly after..."
lines.zh: 最后她让我走，好回去专心做她的事，于是我很快又走下台阶……"
